ecosystem_leverage.description: Reusable gain across tare.tools projects and qualified model consumers.

community_innovation.description: Distinct public research or engineering value beyond generic harness and router work.

information_per_cost.description: Decision-relevant information delivered per unit of compute and implementation effort.

evidence_readiness.description: Availability of immutable inputs, executable treatment and independent scoring.

downstream_unlock.description: Number and importance of later decisions enabled by the result.

BACKLOG-SLX08-SEMANTIC-PREFILL-12.reason: R11 established a physical half-context speed path; charging semantic selection cost on natural documents is the smallest experiment that can decide whether the mechanism is useful to tare.tools agents rather than only to an exact-key fixture.
BACKLOG-SLX08-SEMANTIC-PREFILL-12.change_trigger: Independent R11 promotion closed physical route and uncertainty defects while explicitly leaving semantic selection, natural documents and selector-inclusive latency unqualified.

BACKLOG-ADAPT06-SLOP-LIVE-06.reason: Two real adapters already route successfully; binding schedules and isolated route counterfactuals can qualify a reusable specialization primitive for tare.tools agents with little new machinery.
BACKLOG-ADAPT06-SLOP-LIVE-06.change_trigger: Independent audit found a bounded live positive but held R5 because cache and schedule rows were outside the receipt and lacked route-correct counterfactuals.

BACKLOG-SLX08-PHYSICAL-PREFILL-04.reason: A physical selected-block prefill route could improve long-context latency across serving consumers and turn the verified offline mechanism into a community-relevant systems result.
BACKLOG-SLX08-PHYSICAL-PREFILL-04.change_trigger: R3 independently verified the retained-context fidelity false negative, removing the offline-mechanism uncertainty while leaving runtime integration as the decisive gap.

BACKLOG-HUMAN-JUDGE-CALIBRATION-01.reason: Blind human labels calibrate scorers across experiment families, but the required label packet does not yet exist.
BACKLOG-HUMAN-JUDGE-CALIBRATION-01.change_trigger: The SLX08 audit added another concrete scorer-induced false negative to the existing cross-cutting calibration risk.

BACKLOG-GDN02-LEARNED-STATE-02.reason: Retaining three decisive state cells and 147 collateral cosines can cheaply close a novel learned-state editing question with independently recomputable evidence.
BACKLOG-GDN02-LEARNED-STATE-02.change_trigger: Independent audit found the R1 negative indication scientifically unsigned only because decisive vectors and per-record collateral values were not retained.

BACKLOG-BEE-L5-LIVE-GUARD-04.reason: Early stream termination could reduce agent serving waste, but the current Python guard misses its overhead budget and lacks server-side cancellation evidence; redesign is needed before another run.
BACKLOG-BEE-L5-LIVE-GUARD-04.change_trigger: Independent audit confirmed the strict overhead failure and showed that trigger presence was incorrectly used as proof of physical abort and token savings.

BACKLOG-BEE-L2-KV-CODEC-01.reason: A physical immutable KV codec would benefit constrained serving, but no executable format or route receipt exists yet.
BACKLOG-BEE-L2-KV-CODEC-01.change_trigger: The audit closed Q8 utility/concurrency positively while leaving codec-level physical realization as a distinct longer-term opportunity.

BACKLOG-HYPER01-REAL-ADAPTER-01.reason: Physical targets show strong fidelity potential, but the frozen FP32 resource gate fails decisively and a useful successor requires a distinct compressed-generator treatment.
BACKLOG-HYPER01-REAL-ADAPTER-01.change_trigger: Independent audit proved the 72.7 MiB resource failure and found the trained generator and generated tensors absent from retained evidence.

BACKLOG-NEGATIVE-KV-REAL-SCREEN-02.reason: The five real-KV candidates remain scientifically interesting, but none is near its gate and retaining decisive tensors would be costly relative to expected reversal value.
BACKLOG-NEGATIVE-KV-REAL-SCREEN-02.change_trigger: Independent audit preserved all negative indications but could not recompute them because activation and weight tensors were not retained.

BACKLOG-THINKINGCAP-QWEN38-01.reason: An official 3090-fit ThinkingCap Qwen3.8 artifact could improve the qualified fleet, but no such weights currently exist.
BACKLOG-THINKINGCAP-QWEN38-01.change_trigger: Post-audit fleet coverage is strong enough that this remains an external artifact watch rather than an active experiment.

BACKLOG-PACKED-HARDWARE-01.reason: Packed hardware remains potentially valuable but generic; the concrete SLX08 physical route now offers a better-defined systems target.
BACKLOG-PACKED-HARDWARE-01.change_trigger: The audit converted SLX08 from proxy uncertainty into a concrete physical-integration candidate, reducing the value of an unselected generic packed experiment.
